English: Earthen Pit

A primitive, hastily-dug pit lined with dry grasses, used to store grain and roots in the Central African wilds. Vulnerable to rain and pests, but a vital first step for any nomad seeking to survive the Sahel.
Woven Basket
Grain and seeds are stored in tightly-bound baskets woven from reeds and grasses, raising them above the damp earth. Enables more secure storage and easier transport for migratory clans.
Mudbrick Hut
Simple mudbrick huts are built as semi-permanent silos, protecting stores from rain and most pests. These structures mark the transition from mere survival to true settlement.
Thatched Silo
A large, circular silo with a thick thatched roof, built to keep out rain and heat. Improved storage means less grain is spoiled, supporting a growing clan and larger herds.
Rodent-Proof Store
Elevated and sealed storage chambers, built atop stone or wood stilts, with smooth plastered walls to deter rodents. Greatly reduces spoilage, keeping the clan well-fed year-round.
Guarded Pavilion
Armed guards are stationed to protect granary goods from both wild animals and jealous neighbors. The presence of sentries increases clan unity and attracts new followers.
Market Storehall
A bustling gathering point for trade caravans, where surplus grain is exchanged for goods and services. Market regulation brings prosperity and promotes population growth.
Expanded Granary
A sprawling complex of interconnected silos and storage huts, able to hold the bounty of numerous harvests. Supports vast population surges and makes large-scale mobilization possible.
Grain Exchange Hall
A central hall for the storage, weighing, and distribution of grain, complete with scribes and overseers. The grain exchange cements your clan as a regional power in commerce and logistics.
Central African Granary

The apex of storage and logistics: this monumental grainhouse features stone-lined vaults, guarded storehouses, and bustling grain markets. The pride of Central Africa, it enables your clan to rival the greatest settled realms of the world.
